g.text: SD06 — Story Memory, Journal and Event History (UC09, UC12; F09, F11)
Update story memory (every published event, from SD05)
[keyFact: a death, a quest outcome, or any event
with a non-zero alignment delta (e.g. a theft)]
(isValid: summary does not contradict the fixed facts;
fallback: the events' own descriptions, joined)
